title: Candidate invariant summarizer
purpose: Propose repeated class, parity, range, or aggregate properties for later proof or attack.

title: Bounded conjecture attacker
purpose: Search one explicitly finite domain for a counterexample and preserve the exact scope even when none is found.

title: Cycle detector
purpose: Detect exact repeated states in finite/integer traces and tolerance-dependent candidate periods in binary64 traces.

title: Fixed-point detector
purpose: Report exact fixed states for finite maps and declared analytic candidates for supported numeric kernels.

title: Finite functional-graph analyzer
purpose: Exhaustively compute cycles, weak components, and basin assignments for a finite total map.

title: Perturbation growth summary
purpose: Measure finite binary64 separation between two recorded trajectories without declaring chaos.

title: Bounded run summary
purpose: Describe completion state, bounds, extrema, and output size for every supported experiment family.
